property_summary: After correctRState transitions from BELOW_ONE to ONE, the ratio of BASE_TARGET_ to QUOTE_TARGET_ must equal the current price I_
After a BELOW_ONE to ONE transition via correctRState, _BASE_TARGET_ decreases by exactly the same basis points as _QUOTE_TARGET_ from their pre-transition values.
After correctRState changes RState from BELOW_ONE to ONE, _BASE_TARGET_ must equal _BASE_RESERVE_.

After correctRState is triggered during buyShares when totalSupply > 0 and the state transitions from BELOW_ONE to ONE, the new _BASE_TARGET_ equals the post-mint base balance divided by (1 + mintRatio).
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the BASE_TARGET_ should equal BASE_RESERVE_ whenever RState_ is ONE; the bug omits this reset in the BELOW_ONE correction path, leaving a stale BASE_TARGET_.
